lines.zh: 扛着盾走，肩头磨出了茧。
lines.en: Marching under the shield has callused my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我跟着前面那面盾的边。
lines.en: I walk along the rim of the shield ahead.
Short strides keep the rank even.

lines.zh: 背上这面木盾，比看起来沉。
lines.en: This wooden shield is heavier than it looks.
My boots ring along the stone road.

lines.zh: 前后左右都是人，走得踏实。
lines.en: Men on every side; the march feels solid.
The standard leads; I mind my heels.
On the turn, I pull the shield inward.

lines.zh: 我不抢第一排，也不落后。
lines.en: I neither rush the front nor lag behind.
Mud is what tires a march most.
The gladius bumps against my hip.
We march until dark on this road.

lines.zh: 站住时我靠着盾喘口气。
lines.en: Standing, I lean on the shield and catch my breath.
The front rank is ahead; I wait.
I tap the hilt twice with a finger.
My hair is soaked under the helmet.
The column is long; I cannot see its tail.

lines.zh: 我朝旁边的人挤了挤眼。
lines.en: I trade a glance with the man beside me.
Fifteen points of armor is a hot thing.
I rest the shield against my knee.
In the quiet, my mind turns home.
At any noise, my head comes up.
Are you new? I do not know your face.
Your boots have not seen long roads.
I look at your belt first.
That is not a uniform you wear.
Your smile is a friendly one.
I let you speak first.

lines.zh: 你的手在身后，我看不到。
lines.en: Your hand is behind you where I cannot see.
It is awkward talking from that distance.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但也不怕你。
lines.en: I do not know you, and I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在找我的盾缝吗？
lines.en: Are your eyes hunting a gap in my shield?
I yelp and give half a step.
The plate caught most of it, and it still hurts.
I clutch my ribs and breathe hard.
This wound would make a good story at home.
I bite down and set the shield straight.
Blood drips down the hem of my tunic.
The pain throbs behind my eyes.
I shake out my numb hand.
I will not fall; I have to rejoin the line.
I look up at you with fire in my eyes.
Is that bread? I smell wheat.
The column's rations are still behind us.
Let me try a small piece.
A little salt would make it perfect.
What a march wants most is hot soup.

lines.zh: 你分我一半，我替你扛盾。
lines.en: Half for me and I will carry your shield.
Not all of it; others are watching.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起家门口。
lines.en: This smell takes me to my own doorway.
I eat fast; do not mind me.
Chewing while marching is its own luxury.
Hey, that was my foot.
I shift my shield toward you.
Do not push; the front has not moved.
Our armor clanks together.
Half a step back and there is room.
The road narrows when there are many of us.
I steady myself on your shoulder.
Bump me; the plate is thick.
Do not squeeze me out of the column.
I turn sideways to let you by.
Talk like that in camp and I will be punished.
I am young; let me earn some honor first.
The men in my tent would laugh at me.
Let us speak after this battle.
I have not even finished a letter home.
Camp has rules enough already.
I keep my mind on the shield.
Do not tease me about it.
When I am discharged, I will go home and marry.
Stand up straight; people are watching.
That coin on the ground is mine now.
Whose waterskin is this?
I pick it up and pass it back.
This could trade for half a jug of wine.
I prop the shield on the ground to stoop.
Not mine, but it serves me now.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进盾后的袋子。
lines.en: I tuck it into the pouch behind my shield.
Nothing on the ground goes to waste.
This stone is a curious thing.
I hold it up and ask who wants it.
You there, halt.
I turn the shield toward you.

lines.zh: 你踏进我的视野，就晚了。
lines.en: Step into my sight and it is too late.
The column halts; a target appears.
I will not hide from this fight.
You do not look like much of a fighter.

lines.zh: 我把剑拔出来，手心发汗。
lines.en: I draw the blade, palms damp.
You have stood over there a long time.
I see your hands are bare.
You alone?
I step forward; the shield follows.
You are dead ahead of me.
Come on; I have trained three years.
I fix you with my teeth clenched.
This time I will not be left behind.
I crouch down a little.
I shuffle my feet looking for an angle.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西举得太高。
lines.en: You are holding that too high.
When you miss, I move in.
My shield covers half of me.
Which hand do you favor?
I am guessing your next move.
Our scuta form a wall and press toward you.
Do not think I am afraid.
My comrades are watching me.
I should make this look good.
My legs shake; I force them still.
This thrust has to be close.
Your shoulder is tipping forward.

lines.zh: 罗马的盾排好，剑在下面。
lines.en: Roman shields locked, swords underneath.

lines.zh: 我的短剑和大盾，是一套的。
lines.en: My gladius and my shield come as one set.
I raise the shield an inch.
There is no road behind you.
I do not want to drag this out.
My teacher said guard first, strike second.
You moved; I saw it.
The gladius goes out from under the shield.
I drive the shield into your chest.
I aim the point at your arm, not your plate.
Short sword and square shield, no holding back.
You stop the shield but not the blade.

lines.zh: 我压着你的武器往下一沉。
lines.en: I press your weapon down.
The point flicks along your ribs.
Rush in, then stab.
That one felt like proper soldiering.
You fall back; I press on.
The shield rim raps your wrist.
I drive the blade upward.

lines.zh: 剑从盾下刺出，正中肋侧。
lines.en: My sword stabs from under the shield into your ribs.
This thrust goes for your knee.
Shield up, gladius follows.
Your shield is off by three fingers.
A gladius is short, but fast enough.

lines.zh: 这一下是我在营里练的。
lines.en: I drilled this one in camp.
Retreat, and the point follows.
I recover the blade to guard my face.
I come in through the camp gate.

lines.zh: 队伍里应该有我的位置。
lines.en: There should be a place for me in the line.
I straighten the helmet strap.
New ground; I look for the standard first.
This armor sits badly on me.
I take my place behind the man ahead.
The blade is new and not yet blooded.
First battle, and I am shaking a little.
I take the shield off my back.
The ground is uneven; it is hard to hold a post.
I settle at the tail of the column.
I hope I do not die today.

lines.zh: 火苗钻进盾缝，我拍着灭火。
lines.en: Flames slip through the shield gap; I slap them out.

lines.zh: 摔下去的时候我把盾垫在下面。
lines.en: I land with the shield under me.

lines.zh: 头盔灌满水，我扯开了系带。
lines.en: The helmet fills with water; I tear the strap loose.

lines.zh: 一声巨响把我从队列里掀走。
lines.en: The blast flings me out of the rank.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我的盾面上，离手不远。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shield, a hand's width away.

lines.zh: 魔法打过来，我的甲在发烫。
lines.en: Magic strikes and my armor runs hot.

lines.zh: 两天没吃东西，我举不动盾。
lines.en: Two days without food and the shield feels like stone.

lines.zh: 雷打上剑尖，我胳膊一抽。
lines.en: Lightning hits the blade tip and my arm jerks.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我连盾带人往下掉。
lines.en: The ground is gone; shield and man drop together.
